features:
## Sorcerer Features

### Spellcasting
*1st-level sorcerer feature*

An event in your past, or in the life of a parent or ancestor, left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with arcane magic. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your sorcerer spells. You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus for your sorcerer spells.

You know four cantrips of your choice from the sorcerer spell list at 1st level. You learn additional cantrips of your choice at higher levels (5 at 4th, 6 at 10th).

You know two 1st-level sorcerer spells at 1st level. You learn an additional sorcerer spell of your choice at each level except 12th, 18th, and 20th. You can replace one sorcerer spell you know with another sorcerer spell of your choice when you gain a level.

### Sorcerous Origin
*1st-level sorcerer feature*

Choose a sorcerous origin, which describes the source of your innate magical power. Your choice grants you features when you choose it at 1st level and again at 6th, 14th, and 18th level.

### Font of Magic
*2nd-level sorcerer feature*

At 2nd level, you tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects.

**Sorcery Points.** You have a number of sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level. You can never have more sorcery points than your sorcerer level. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

**Flexible Casting.** You can use your sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. To create a spell slot of a given level, expend the following sorcery points: 1st (2), 2nd (3), 3rd (5), 4th (6), 5th (7). You can transform an unexpended spell slot into a number of sorcery points equal to the slot's level.

### Metamagic
*3rd-level sorcerer feature*

At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice. You gain another one at 10th and 17th level. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

- **Careful Spell.** When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force by spending 1 sorcery point. Choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) — they automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell.
- **Distant Spell.** Spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of a spell with a range of 5 feet or greater, or make the range of a touch spell 30 feet.
- **Empowered Spell.** When you roll damage for a spell, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Use the new rolls.
- **Extended Spell.** Spend 1 sorcery point to double the duration of a spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer, to a maximum of 24 hours.
- **Heightened Spell.** Spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of a spell that forces a saving throw disadvantage on its first save against the spell.
- **Quickened Spell.** Spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time of a spell from 1 action to 1 bonus action.
- **Subtle Spell.** Spend 1 sorcery point to cast a spell without any somatic or verbal components.
- **Twinned Spell.** Spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self (1 point for a cantrip).

### Ability Score Improvement
*4th-, 8th-, 12th-, 16th-, and 19th-level sorcerer feature*

When you reach the listed levels, you can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't increase a score above 20 using this feature.

### Sorcerous Restoration
*20th-level sorcerer feature*

At 20th level, you regain 4 expended sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.
